description: Header file defining the MtpDevice class and related structures for managing MTP devices in Android, including device communication, object handling, and session management.

classes.name: MtpDevice
classes.description: Class managing MTP device communication, including session control, object transfer, and event handling.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Static method to open an MTP device given device name and file descriptor.

methods.name: ~MtpDevice
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up MtpDevice resources.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the MTP device connection.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the MTP device connection.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints device information.

methods.name: getDeviceName
methods.description: Returns the device name.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens an MTP session.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes the current MTP session.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information.

methods.name: getStorageIDs
methods.description: Retrieves list of storage IDs.

methods.name: getStorageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information for a specific storage ID.

methods.name: getObjectHandles
methods.description: Retrieves object handles for a storage and format.

methods.name: getObjectInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information for a specific object handle.

methods.name: getThumbnail
methods.description: Retrieves thumbnail for an object.

methods.name: sendObjectInfo
methods.description: Sends object information to the device.

methods.name: sendObject
methods.description: Sends an object to the device.

methods.name: deleteObject
methods.description: Deletes an object from the device.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Gets parent handle of an object.

methods.name: getStorageID
methods.description: Gets storage ID for an object.

methods.name: getObjectPropsSupported
methods.description: Retrieves supported properties for an object format.

methods.name: getDevicePropDesc
methods.description: Gets device property description.

methods.name: setDevicePropValueStr
methods.description: Sets device property value as string.

methods.name: getObjectPropDesc
methods.description: Gets object property description.

methods.name: getObjectPropValue
methods.description: Reads value of a property for an object.

methods.name: readObject
methods.description: Reads an object from the device with various overloads.

methods.name: readPartialObject
methods.description: Reads part of an object with offset and size.

methods.name: readPartialObject64
methods.description: Reads part of an object with 64-bit offset.

methods.name: submitEventRequest
methods.description: Starts a request to read MTP events.

methods.name: reapEventRequest
methods.description: Waits for an MTP event from the device.

methods.name: discardEventRequest
methods.description: Cancels an event request.

methods.name: readObjectInternal
methods.description: Internal method to read an object with size check.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads data with optional size check.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request to the device.

methods.name: sendData
methods.description: Sends data to the device.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads data from the device.

methods.name: writeDataHeader
methods.description: Writes data header for a request.

methods.name: readResponse
methods.description: Reads response from the device.
